projects.title: Classic Learner App
projects.description: A web application that allows to train classical ML algorithms for the given CVS formatted datasets

projects.title: Dataset Generator
projects.description: Streamlit app for generating datasets for machine learning. The app allows users to create datasets with different distributions and noise levels.

projects.title: Diffusion-based Imitation Learning
projects.description: A research project that explores the use of diffusion models for imitation learning. The project includes simple path finding scenario using custom dataset

projects.title: Parallel Tether Control System
projects.description: A control system for a parallel tethered robot. The system use tethers to control elevation and orientation of sensor base to collect data in disaster sites.

projects.title: Grid-based Rotbot Path Generator
projects.description: A Python module that generates a path for a robot to follow in a grid-based environment. The path is generated using the A* algorithm and can be in ROS

projects.title: SSD: Single Shot MultiBox Detector (Keras)
projects.description: An implementation of the SSD object detection algorithm using Keras. This model outputs bounding boxes and class labels for objects in images.

projects.title: EEG Topography Visualization
projects.description: Python application for visualizing EEG data using Matplotlib and NumPy. This script generates topographic maps and animation from EEG data files.
